name: Euro Token
oneLiner: EUROT is Token Teknoloji's centralized euro stablecoin issued from Turkey, backed by euro bank reserves at Ziraat Participation Bank and Akbank.
collateral: Euro bank reserves held by Token Teknoloji at Ziraat Participation Bank and Akbank
pegMechanism: Issuer-managed mint and burn process intended to keep each EUROT matched 1:1 with euro reserves; holders can trade EUROT through Bitlo, but no Pharos-reviewed direct redemption backstop is modeled

references.label: Token Teknoloji A.S. - Euro Token (Turkey-domiciled issuer; traded on Bitlo)

mintAuthority.summary: EUROT uses direct, immutable StableCoin deployments on Avalanche and Polygon. On Avalanche, EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb is both owner and supply manager. On Polygon, EOA 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077 is both owner and supply manager, while the Avalanche EOA is the live proposed owner and can claim ownership immediately. Each current owner or supply manager can mint without an on-chain supply cap.

controls.label: EUROT Avalanche supply-manager and owner EOA
controls.capDescription: StableCoin.mint(uint256) has no aggregate supply ceiling and permits either supplyManager() or owner() to mint.
controls.evidence: At Avalanche block 90233120, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb, proposedOwner() was zero, and eth_getCode on the authority returned 0x. Verified StableCoin source permits the owner or supply manager to call uncapped mint(uint256).

controls.label: EUROT Polygon supply-manager and owner EOA
controls.capDescription: StableCoin.mint(uint256) has no aggregate supply ceiling and permits either supplyManager() or owner() to mint.
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90179923, owner() and supplyManager() both returned 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077 and eth_getCode returned 0x. The runtime hash matched Avalanche exactly for this asset, and verified StableCoin source permits the owner or supply manager to call uncapped mint(uint256).

controls.label: EUROT Polygon pending-owner EOA
controls.evidence: At Polygon block 90179923, proposedOwner() returned 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb. Verified Claimable ownership lets this EOA call claimOwnership without another current-owner action, after which owner() can mint or replace the supply manager immediately. eth_getCode returned 0x.

review.evidence: At Avalanche block 90233120 and Polygon block 90179923, both EUROT deployments were direct contracts with zero EIP-1967 implementation, admin, and beacon slots. Their runtime hashes matched at 0x45c952bb677029fdf5df5248fe477025904a47d39ff185773834541e8e520f5c. Avalanche owner and supply manager were EOA 0xff80b391b286887d446b1124820f87d5b049b4fb. Polygon owner and supply manager were EOA 0xd61c0129f6c35a675db6e2a067b31e75b2573077, with the Avalanche EOA staged as proposed owner. Verified source permits each current owner or supply manager to mint uncapped supply and permits the proposed owner to claim Polygon ownership without delay. Mint-tier review (2026-07-15): No named independent attestor, recurring cadence, or dated reserve-to-liability report is public; Token Teknoloji's proof-of-reserves page is issuer-reported and ad hoc. Turkey's Capital Markets Board list matches Token Teknoloji A.S. as being in liquidation, not as an actively prudentially supervised stablecoin issuer.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: EUROT is described by Token Teknoloji as created on its supported blockchains with euro backing for each token issued. No separate cross-chain mint, lockbox, or liquidity bridge route was resolved, so Pharos treats the profile as native issuance on each listed chain.
